tasks.description: Optimize frontend code to reduce load times and improve responsiveness. Focus on reducing unnecessary re-renders and improving DOM manipulation. Use tools like Webpack and code splitting to optimize bundle sizes.
acceptance_criteria: Given a user navigates to the homepage, when the page loads, then the load time is under 2 seconds

tasks.description: Implement caching mechanisms on the backend to reduce database queries and improve response times. Use a caching library like Redis to store frequently accessed data.
acceptance_criteria: Given a user makes a request to a cached endpoint, when the response is returned, then the response time is under 500ms

tasks.description: Migrate database indexes to improve query performance and reduce latency. Use indexing strategies like composite indexing and covering indexes to optimize queries.
acceptance_criteria: Given a user runs a query, when the query is executed, then the query time is under 100ms

tasks.description: Create a dashboard to monitor and track performance metrics like load times, response times, and error rates. Use tools like New Relic or Datadog to collect and visualize performance data.
acceptance_criteria: Given a user navigates to the dashboard, when the dashboard loads, then the dashboard displays current performance metrics

tasks.description: Write automated testing scripts to simulate user interactions and measure performance metrics like load times and response times. Use tools like Selenium or Cypress to write and run performance tests.
acceptance_criteria: Given a user runs a performance test, when the test is completed, then the test reports performance metrics

tasks.description: Identify and fix slow database queries that are causing performance bottlenecks. Use tools like EXPLAIN and query analysis to identify and optimize slow queries.
acceptance_criteria: Given a user runs a query, when the query is executed, then the query time is under 50ms

tasks.description: Implement code splitting to reduce bundle sizes and improve load times. Use tools like Webpack and code splitting libraries to split code into smaller chunks.
acceptance_criteria: Given a user navigates to a page, when the page loads, then the load time is under 1.5 seconds
